clock: the generated_at of each case document in tests/fixtures/schema/documents/cases/
model_only: model-only/ holds the model documents of cases_without_inputs: the hydrator cannot rebuild those cases, so lockrot did not write them
baseline_2: the gate-row baselines of tests/fixtures/schema/documents/baseline/gate-rows/, read by Baseline::fromArray() and written by BaselineFile::write()
case_lock: each case is formatted beside a composer.lock of its lock entries, as tests/Support/CaseHydrator.php lockJson() lays it out

page_goldens.source: the model's page goldens (security-axis/r3/page-goldens.json in the private model), copied byte for byte and not recorded
page_goldens.read_by: tests/Integration/PageGoldensTest.php reads title and description; the other keys are the renderer's

bundle_sha256: sha256 of the lines "<sha256>  <path>", one per bundle file sorted by path below tests/fixtures/: every file of contract/ but cache/, provenance.json and bundle_sha256, and each baselined/*/check/report.bundle.json
